prediction_score_lifecycle_check.name: prediction_score_lifecycle_check
prediction_score_lifecycle_check.value:
(
        ("prediction"."score" IS NULL AND "prediction"."scored_at" IS NULL AND "prediction"."score_source_version" IS NULL)
        OR ("prediction"."score" IS NOT NULL AND "prediction"."score" >= 0 AND "prediction"."scored_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "prediction"."score_source_version" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("prediction"."score_source_version")) > 0)
      )

newsletter_edition_broadcast_check.name: newsletter_edition_broadcast_check
newsletter_edition_broadcast_check.value:
"newsletter_edition"."state" NOT IN ('broadcast_created', 'sending', 'sent')
        OR ("newsletter_edition"."broadcast_id" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("newsletter_edition"."broadcast_id")) > 0)

newsletter_edition_active_lease_check.name: newsletter_edition_active_lease_check
newsletter_edition_active_lease_check.value: "newsletter_edition"."state" NOT IN ('reserved', 'creating', 'broadcast_created', 'sending') OR "newsletter_edition"."lease_expires_at" IS NOT NULL
